invariant: Together ownership follows CucaDiagram's actual heterogeneous stack, not a lexical search. currentTogether returns a Together only when the top stack item is a Together. gotoTogether therefore records the current top Together as parent, but a package pushed by gotoGroup is a hard ownership boundary: a Together opened inside that package has no outer Together parent and is owned by the package. reallyCreateLeaf and gotoGroup assign the current top Together exactly once when a new leaf or group is materialized. Relationship commands can be the first materializer, and later declarations or sibling scopes reuse the existing entity without moving or duplicating its Together identity. Cluster.printCluster2 emits ordinary nodes first and then root Together subgraphs in first-seen order; printTogether emits each scope's direct leaves, direct child clusters, and direct child Together scopes. The invisible subgraphs constrain Graphviz placement but contribute no painted geometry to SvekResult.calculateDimension. CucaDiagram.applySingleStrategy appends Magma/SquareMaker invisible links only after user links have been collected.
causal_divergence: The first implementation scans backward through ClassScope entries, so it incorrectly carries an outer Together across a package boundary. It enrolls entities only after explicit declarations instead of at create_entity_at_path, missing relationship-created leaves, and it allows a reused entity to be appended to a second sibling Together. That duplicate membership makes graphviz_node_creation_order contain more entries than nodes, panics in debug, and silently emits a different wrong graph in release. LayoutGraph also creates the complete Together subgraph tree before grouped nodes and visible child clusters, unlike Cluster.printTogether's recursive statement order. The retained package-only control proves that some package-heavy SVG divergence predates Together and must not be explained by this mechanism. The SquareMaker link phase and top-level invisible-versus-painted envelope portions survived independent 3/4/5-node held-outs.
planned_change: Mirror Java's stack-top semantics with one authoritative structural stack. Move entity Together assignment into the first-materialization path shared by declarations and relationship endpoints, and move package assignment into first group materialization; store one immutable owner per entity or package and derive each TogetherGroup's direct member lists from those owners so redeclaration cannot duplicate or migrate membership. A Together opened with a package on top gets no Together parent. Make layout emission recursive in Java order: ordinary nodes first, then each root Together subgraph containing direct nodes, direct visible child clusters, and child Together subgraphs. Preserve the already validated trailing Magma/SquareMaker links and painted-envelope exclusion. Keep the unrelated package-only control executable and treat any remaining failure there as a separate package-layout dependency rather than adding fixture-shaped branches.
